_meta.verification: Table is by PRODUCT (per its spec), so I spot-checked 10 sub-entries/claims against sources the researcher did not cite where possible. (1) Rate baseline: Freddie Mac PMMS weekly prints for July 2026 are 6.43 (Jul 2), 6.49 (Jul 9), 6.55 (Jul 16), 6.58 (Jul 23) — the ~6.55 MORTGAGE30US anchor and implied 7.55/7.18/10.55 note rates are ACCURATE (freddiemac.gcs-web.com, globenewswire, Fox Business). (2) Agency cash-out seasoning: CONFIRMED — SEL-2023-01 (announced Feb 1, 2023) requires the first lien being paid off to be >=12 months old note-date-to-note-date, mandatory for note dates on/after Apr 1, 2023; checked via Black Mann & Graham, Florida Capital Bank, and Homebridge lender bulletins (none cited by researcher). (3) Delayed financing exception: CONFIRMED — all-cash purchase may cash-out inside 6 months capped at purchase price + closing costs, arm's-length + documented funds (mymortgageinsider, lendfriendmtg — uncited). (4) Investment-property LLPAs 2.125 pts at 70.01-75 LTV / 3.375 at 75.01-80 (post-May-2023 matrix): CONFIRMED via fitsmallbusiness and Griffin Funding LLPA explainer (primary fanniemae.com PDF 403s for me too; FICO-grid stacking remains estimated:true, appropriately). (5) Eligibility-matrix LTVs: CONFIRMED — 1-unit investment purchase 85% absolute max, cash-out 75% (1-unit) / 70% (2-4 unit), 2-4 unit purchase 75%. (6) Property condition: CONFIRMED — C6 ineligible until repaired subject-to >=C5; C5 eligible as-is only if deficiencies don't affect safety/soundness/structural integrity; lender overlays stricter (McKissock, homebuyer.com, musketeermortgage — mixed cited/uncited). (7) DSCR rate level: independent July-2026 sheets (dscrcapitalpartners, homeabroadinc, hostfinancial — uncited) quote standard files ~6.75-7.75 and best-tier 6.125-6.5; the +1.00 central spread (7.55%) sits mid-band and inside the stated +0.75-1.5 range — PLAUSIBLE/CONFIRMED, slightly conservative for strong-FICO files (fine for an engine default that includes the 3-2-1-PPP

rules:
UNIT CONVENTION (single, consistent): all rates, spreads, points, penalties and fee percentages are in PERCENT units (1.0 = 1.00%); all ratios (LTV, LTC, LTARV, DSCR) are DECIMAL fractions (0.75 = 75%, DSCR 1.2 = 1.20x). Dollar fields are absolute USD. This intentionally differs from the old data_providers.py decimal-fraction tax rates — the new engine should normalize everything at load.

ENGINE APPLICATION (BRRRR default path, July 2026, FRED MORTGAGE30US ~= 6.55):
(1) ACQUISITION = HARD_MONEY: note rate = MORTGAGE30US + 4.00 = 10.55% I/O on drawn balance; 2.0 points + ~$2,000 fixed + $250/draw (assume 4 draws). Loan sizing = min(0.85 x (purchase + rehab), 0.90 x purchase + 1.00 x rehab, 0.70 x ARV) — the 0.70 LTARV cap binds on heavy value-add deals and sets the cash-in. Term 12 months; base case 6-month carry, downside case one 6-month extension at +1.0 point. Use 0.75 LTARV only in an 'experienced investor' toggle.
(2) REFI = DSCR cash-out (default exit): rate = MORTGAGE30US + 1.00 + 0.25 cash-out add = 7.80%; 2.0 points + $1,750 fixed; max 0.75 x ARV; seasoning 3-6 months (0-3 month programs cap proceeds at cost basis — so the engine's month-6 refi at full ARV is the realistic base case, matching the 6-month hard-money carry). Refi must pass DSCR >= 1.20 at market rent for par pricing (floor 1.00 with +0.5 rate / -0.05 LTV); if DSCR < 1.0, BRRRR refi fails — score the metro on the flip path instead. Prepay penalty on the refi loan: default 3-2-1 (already included via the +0.25 in the 1.00 spread vs a 5-4-3-2-1 base); a 5-yr hold sells at month 60, after the 3-2-1 expires (month 36), so the exit penalty is $0 — do NOT model a prepay hit on the 5-yr hold. In no-PPP states (see DSCR.state_notes) add +0.375 to the DSCR rate instead.
(3) CONV_INVEST is the cheaper refi/purchase alternative ONLY for cosmetic-scope deals or all-cash acquisitions: effective rate = MORTGAGE30US + 0.625 at <=0.75 LTV (+0.875 at 0.80) with ~1 point; hard-money-financed deals must wait 12 months (note seasoning) so it is NOT the default BRRRR exit; C5/C6-condition acquisitions (any gut/heavy scope) cannot fund conventional at purchase.
(4) FLIP MODE reuses HARD_MONEY as the only loan (no refi leg).
(5) FLOORS: if 0.75 x ARV < $100k (ARV < ~$135k) or the hard-money loan < $100k, mark the metro/deal 'non-financeable' — this bites in the cheapest Midwest/South metros and must gate the ranking. Store SPREADS, not absolute rates: recompute note rates from live MORTGAGE30US each precompute run.
notes: Verification status: DSCR spread (+0.75 to +1.5 over conforming; standard-tier files 7.00-8.00% in July 2026), prepay structures/rate-adds, and hard-money rate/points/LTARV bands were each corroborated by 2+ independent July-2026 lender/rate-sheet sources. Fannie 12-month note-date seasoning for cash-out (effective Apr-2023), 6-month title seasoning, delayed-financing exception, 75% max cash-out LTV (1-unit investment), and C6/Q6 ineligibility per B4-1.3-06 are current agency rules confirmed via selling-guide summaries. The investment-property LLPAs (2.125 pts at 70.01-75 LTV, 3.375 pts at 75.01-80) come from secondary sources quoting the post-May-2023 FHFA matrix — the fanniemae.com matrix PDF itself returned 403 to fetch — so the FICO-grid stacking figure is marked estimated:true; the derived effective spreads (+0.625/+0.875) are the industry-standard conversion (~4-5 pts per 1% rate) and safe for ranking purposes. State-variation adders (no-PPP states, thin hard-money coverage states) are lender-overlay-dependent and marked estimated:true — they shift returns ~10-25 bps, not rankings. This task's table is by PRODUCT (DSCR/CONV_INVEST/HARD_MONEY/REFI) per the task spec, not by state; state effects are encoded as notes with flat adders.

DSCR.product: 30-yr fixed DSCR investor loan (non-QM, business purpose)

sub_1_0_dscr.note: no-ratio programs exist at ~70% max LTV

DSCR.min_loan_note: many lenders floor at $100k (some $75k); properties whose loan amount would be below this are effectively non-financeable via DSCR

prepay_penalty.note: 3-2-1 penalty fully expires after month 36, so a 5-yr hold exits penalty-free; a 5-4-3-2-1 only clears at month 60+ (boundary risk) — engine default is 3-2-1 with the +0.25 rate add

state_notes.note: prepay penalties on 1-4 unit investor loans are restricted or prohibited in several states (lender sheets commonly flag AK, KS, MI, MN, NM, OH, RI, VT, NJ, and PA below the Act-6 base figure — $329,411 for calendar 2026, adjusted annually; NJ prohibition applies to individual borrowers but not LLC/entity borrowers; MD structure-dependent); lenders there price roughly +0.25 to +0.50 in lieu of PPP

llpa_investment_property.note: FHFA/Fannie LLPA matrix (May-2023 redesign, still in effect); FICO/LTV grid LLPA stacks on top (~0.375-0.875 pts for 740-779 at 75-80% LTV); lenders convert points to rate at roughly 4-5 pts per 1% rate

CONV_INVEST.documentation: full income doc, DTI <= 45-50% — not usable for DTI-constrained or entity borrowers

property_condition_limits.rule: C6/Q6 ineligible per Fannie B4-1.3-06 — appraisal must be completed subject-to repair to at least C5 before delivery; C5 is technically eligible as-is but widespread lender overlays decline C5
property_condition_limits.excluded_scopes: gut/down-to-studs renovations, non-functional kitchen/bath/mechanicals, active roof leaks, structural or safety deficiencies — i.e., the typical BRRRR heavy-rehab acquisition will NOT fund conventional; only cosmetic/light-remodel scopes qualify at purchase
property_condition_limits.engine_rule: offer CONV_INVEST only when rehab scope class is cosmetic/light; heavy/gut scopes must route acquisition through HARD_MONEY

HARD_MONEY.product: Hard-money / fix-and-flip bridge loan (purchase + rehab) — the BRRRR acquisition loan
HARD_MONEY.interest_type: interest-only, monthly; many lenders charge on drawn balance only (Kiavi-style), others on full commitment — engine default: interest on drawn balance
HARD_MONEY.extension_note: priced per 3-6 month extension on outstanding balance; engine base case = 6-month carry with no extension, downside case = one 6-month extension (+1 pt)

state_notes.note: licensing-heavy states (AZ, NV, UT, OR, ND, SD, VT, MN) have thinner lender coverage; judicial-foreclosure states (NY, NJ, IL) price ~+0.25 to +0.75 and many national HMLs exclude NY (esp. NYC 1-4 unit)

REFI.product: BRRRR cash-out refinance rules (the R that returns the cash)

conventional_path.note_seasoning_rule: Fannie SEL rule effective Apr-2023: any existing first lien being paid off by a cash-out refi must be >= 12 months old, note date to note date — so a hard-money-financed BRRRR cannot conventional cash-out until month 12
conventional_path.delayed_financing_exception: all-cash purchases may cash-out within 6 months but loan is capped at documented cost basis (purchase + closing), not ARV; after 6 months on title with no lien to pay off, full appraised-value cash-out allowed
conventional_path.engine_rule: model conventional refi only for all-cash acquisitions at month 6+ using appraised ARV at 75% LTV

zero_seasoning.constraint: 0-3 month seasoning caps loan at lower of appraised ARV vs cost basis (purchase + documented rehab) at 75% LTV, typically 700+ FICO (Easy Street Capital-style); a few lenders allow full ARV at 0-3 months with pricing adds

dscr_path.engine_rule: BRRRR default exit = DSCR cash-out at 75% of ARV after 3-6 months seasoning; note rate = MORTGAGE30US + 1.00 (DSCR spread) + 0.25 (cash-out) = 7.80% at Jul-2026; points ~2.0 + ~$1,750 fixed; min DSCR 1.20 computed at the refi rate on market rent — if DSCR < 1.0 the refi fails and cash stays trapped (engine must check)

REFI.min_refi_note: 75% of ARV must exceed ~$100k (i.e., ARV >= ~$135k) for the DSCR refi to exist — flag cheap metros below this as non-financeable via BRRRR
